Everything inside the house (the Operating System, all applications, and data) is safe from the outside world (the Cloud Provider/Hypervisor), then by some chance if a thief manages to get inside the house (e.g., a malware infection in your Guest OS), they can steal everything. Intel SGX on the the other hand is like placing a steel vault inside a room in your house. Even if the house has no walls and thieves (compromised OS or Hypervisor) are roaming freely, they ca…

articles.author: christal riziki
articles.description:
Introduction


React is one of the most popular JavaScript libraries for building modern user interfaces. For beginners, the biggest challenge is often not React itself, but setting up the development environment correctly. This article walks through a simple, modern, and reliable way to set up your first React project using Node.js, Vite, and Visual Studio Code, while addressing common issues beginners face.
Prerequisites


Before starting a React project, you need the following:
A computer running Windows, Linux, or macOS
Node.js (LTS version recommended)
npm (comes bundled with Node.js)
Visual Studio Code 
Installing Node.js
Download Node.js from the official website:

After installation, verify it by running:
node -v

Why Use Vite Instead of Create React App?
Vite is a modern build tool that provides:
Faster startup time
Instant hot reload
Minimal configuration
Industry adoption for modern React projects
Run the following command in your terminal:
npm create vite@latest my-first-react-app
When prompted, select:
Framework: React
Variant: TypeScript /Javascript (Work with a languange that you best understand)
Use rolldown-vite ?
What Is rolldown-vite?
rolldown-vite is an experimental version of Vite that uses a new Rust-based bundler. While it promises better performance, it is not recommended for beginners due to limited documentation and potential instability.
Always choose No when a beginner in  React.
Installing Dependencies
Navigate into the project folder and install dependencies:
cd my-first-react-app
Lastly Open your first react project in your Vs Code.
articles.title: Setting Up Your First React Project with Vite and VS Code
